review.why: Reviews a product manager resume against 10 practices (XYZ+S bullets, keywords, structure), quoting the resume.
review.summary: Prompt-style reviewer for PM resumes: a friendly intro, feedback on ten practices (summary, no pronouns, concision, XYZ+S bullets, professional email, tailoring, skills shown in bullets, section order, new graduates and career changers, standard titles), then a conclusion. An optional job posting tailors the feedback.
strengths: Ten concrete practices, each with an evaluation and guidance
Requires quotes from the user's own resume
Optional job posting steers the feedback
cautions: Opinionated rules (no pronouns, one to two pages, XYZ+S on 70% of bullets)
Ends with links to the author's own articles and course
